# Creative Market

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 29 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Creative-asset marketplace storefronts: 73px header with a 585px All-Categories search pill and category nav, illustrated hero + 337px product cards with teal price pills and hover Add To Cart, filter-pill category grids, a 450px buy box with 24px license radio rows and teal/outlined purchase buttons, shop cards, membership plan cards and a username/password sign-in card.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; the account dashboard, purchases, downloads, checkout and the sell studio sit behind the /sign-in card and were never reached; no form was submitted, nothing was added to the cart and no consent button was pressed). Themes: light.

Creative Market's public signed-out surface — the home page, the /fonts category, a product page, /search, /membership and the /sign-in card — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and category pages at 390 x 844. The account, purchases, downloads and the sell studio sit behind sign-in; Log In was never pressed and nothing was added to the cart.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
